lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li₂Sb₂S₄ (reduced formula LiSbS₂) adopts the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral Li centers coordinated by four S neighbors and octahedral Sb centers coordinated by six S neighbors; the S centers show five geometric neighbors (one Li, four Sb). Corner-sharing is observed between Li tetrahedra and Sb octahedra, and between S octahedra, while Li tetrahedra and S octahedra also show edge-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
